read_sentences_from_file: read sentences from a text file with optional sentence segmentation using segtok
present_annotated_sentences: present annotated sentences with their detected entity mentions to stdout or a file
sentence_mentions_pairs: pair sentences with their corresponding mentions by sentence index for entity linking
write_dicts_as_json_per_line: write a list of dictionaries as JSON lines to a file for mentions or sentences
write_end2end_pickle_output: write sentences and mentions to a pickle file for end-to-end entity linking output
